svg.title: Proposed membership state machine
svg.desc: Admission establishes Alive. Suspicion and matching failure evidence advance state. Only a newer owner announcement refutes suspicion or death; leave closes the epoch and requires a newer epoch to rejoin.

span.p:
Connection and membership are separate.
Relayed identity alone grants no admission.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same pair: Dead > Suspect > Alive.
ACK alone does not refute a suspicion.
Persist rejection floor before terminal publication.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Left closes the entire epoch.
Same-epoch updates cannot reopen it.
